title: Merged-branch margins on LCM laws live only in wasted cells and never compile
statement: For d_psi = d_lambda = 1, atomless centered P with nonsingular covariance, tie-nullity, and linear conditional means on every relevant nondegenerate tilt: every full-rank bounded-packet stationary quantizer has non-distinct projected centroids; after merging coincident projected-centroid groups, the reduced rule is a genuine strip rule with K' <= K-1 and rank(I_reduced) <= 1, hence its nuisance/full-rank margin vanishes. Its profiled value equals the between-value of e_q on the reduced intervals and is at most v_K. Under bare (L), only the non-distinctness conclusion is asserted. On N(0,I_2), the explicit sign-split family is stationary, has B*_q = 0, profiled value 2/pi, and lambda_min up to 1/pi, proving the closed population class defining v*(kappa) nonempty for kappa <= 1/pi. This does not prove attainment, continuity, empirical exchange-stable tracking, or a universal v_3-v_2 price; 0.1732 is the measured loss of that explicit Gaussian family.
assumptions: d_psi = d_lambda = 1; atomless P; tie hyperplanes null ((M4) suffices); E S = 0, finite second moments
centered nonsingular LCM implies (L) at shat because Cov(S_lambda, shat) = 0; LCM on the tilt range containing B*_q is required for the reduced-rule rank collapse; conclusion (1) needs only (L)

the Gaussian sign-split construction uses a nontrivial nuisance-measurable split with positive subcell masses and nonzero subcell nuisance means; its maximum lambda_min = 1/pi occurs at the zero threshold
stationarity is DS12 bounded-packet stationarity with I_q > 0; no claim about finite exchange-stable states tracking these configurations (that empirical question is part of the OP30 rescope)

value identity uses the DS11 variational normal equation at B = B*_q; the sharp bound Phi(q) <= v_{K-1}(shat-law) is proved only when B*_q = B*_pop (e.g. nuisance-sign-symmetric configurations) and is otherwise open

proof_location.section: DS17. Inhabitation of the margin-certified branch: the conditional-centering obstruction and the fixed-point gate

role: classifies the (M5)-free escape of the obstruction: margins survive only by wasting cells on profiled-information-free splits, and feed the DS16 attainment question a nonvacuous feasible class
warning: Audit-hardened. Nonemptiness of the closed population class {lambda_min >= kappa} does not prove attainment or continuity of v*(kappa), identify v*+(kappa), or produce empirical exchange-stable sequences. The N=3 exact boundary is support-minimal but atomically packet-vacuous; the N=8 fixture is a structured symmetric control, not globally minimal. The reduced-rule rank conclusion is LCM-scoped.
